newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Heavy down on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Heavy down on profit taking.

text.p: Shares in Mitsubishi Heavy Industries Ltd declined on Friday morning, weighed down by profit taking by investors ahead of the end of the fiscal year on March 31, traders said.
The heavy machinery manufacturer's shares were down 16 yen at 809 at 0054 GMT. Volume was 1.274 million shares, making it the fifth most-active issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
"Sales related to end-March book closings continued," said a broker at a major securities house. Participants took profits in blue-chip issues early amid the weak overall tone in the market.
